hadith:
Fear Prayer - Narrated Nafi`:

Ibn `Umar said something similar to Mujahid's saying: Whenever (Muslims and non-Muslims) stand face to face in battle, the Muslims can pray while standing. Ibn `Umar added, "The Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'If the number of the enemy is greater than the Muslims, they can pray while standing or riding (individually).' "
message: In times of conflict or hardship, remember that Allah is Al Hakam, the Supreme Judge, who sees all things justly. He encourages us to seek forgiveness and reconciliation, reminding us through the Quran that words spoken out of anger should never harm our relationships unjustly. Let these teachings guide us towards patience, understanding, and compassion in our interactions with others.
name:
Al Hakam - الْحَكَمُ - The Judge

The name Al Hakam emphasizes Allah's role as the supreme judge who determines justice and fairness. It signifies His authority to rule over His creation and to decide matters, rewarding the righteous and punishing the wrongdoers. The use of this name serves to remind believers of the ultimate accountability they have in the Hereafter.
verse:
Al-Mujadila - The Pleading Woman - 58:2

Those of you who ˹sinfully˺ divorce their wives by comparing them to their mothers ˹should know that˺ their wives are in no way their mothers. None can be their mothers except those who gave birth to them. What they say is certainly detestable and false. Yet Allah is truly Ever-Pardoning, All-Forgiving.
